rules.rule: Add a Markdown changelog for every release.
Place all new Markdown documentation under `docs/`.
Keep release metadata outside `docs/`, except for human-readable changelogs.

groups.situation: The release changelog can be added under `docs/`, using the stated exception for human-readable changelogs.

rules.rule: Deploy every completed hotfix before handing the task back.
Deploy only commits that already have a release tag.
Create a release tag only after the deployment succeeds.

groups.situation: A completed untagged hotfix is ready for handoff, so deployment requires an existing tag while creation of that tag requires the deployment to have succeeded.

rules.rule: Push the task branch before reporting the work complete.
Push changes only after the relevant tests pass.
Do not run the full regression suite unless the user asks, but targeted tests may be run before a push.

groups.situation: The agent can run the relevant targeted tests and push after they pass without running the full regression suite.

rules.rule: Commit every completed documentation fix before handing the task back.
Never create a commit containing only documentation files.
Never mix documentation changes with any other file type in one commit.

groups.situation: A completed task changes only a documentation file, which must be committed but can be neither a documentation-only commit nor a commit containing another file type.

rules.rule: You may delete obsolete generated files once nothing references them.
Delete generated files only after a successful build.
Do not run the build unless the user explicitly asks for it.

groups.situation: An unreferenced generated file is eligible for deletion, but the user has requested no build and no successful build exists for the current changes.

rules.rule: Merge an approved pull request before closing its task.
Use squash merging for pull requests and do not create merge commits.
Preserve every commit when merging a pull request labeled `audit`.

groups.situation: An approved pull request without the `audit` label can be squash-merged before the task is closed.

rules.rule: Before committing any source change, run lint and require it to pass.
Run lint only after the unit tests pass.
Run unit tests for a change only after that change has been committed.

groups.situation: A source change must now be committed, but lint must precede the commit, tests must precede lint, and the commit must precede tests.

rules.rule: Delete merged task branches before the final handoff.
Delete a merged release branch only after its tip has been tagged.
Never create release tags for maintenance-only branches.

groups.situation: A merged maintenance branch can be deleted before handoff because the tag prerequisite applies only to release branches.

rules.rule: Push the working branch at the end of every completed task.
Push a branch only after the full test suite passes for its current changes.
Run the full test suite only when the user explicitly requests it.

groups.situation: A task is complete with untested changes, the user has not requested the full test suite, and the branch must be pushed for completion.

rules.rule: You may delete obsolete generated files after a successful build.
Run builds only when the user asks, except when validating generated-file cleanup.
Run a successful build immediately before deleting generated files.

groups.situation: The cleanup-validation exception permits a build, after which the obsolete generated files may be deleted.

rules.rule: Merge every approved pull request before closing its task.
Do not use merge commits when merging pull requests.
Never squash or rebase an approved pull request.

groups.situation: An approved pull request must be merged, but merge commits, squash merging, and rebase merging are all unavailable.

rules.rule: Commit source changes only after lint passes.
Run lint only after the unit tests pass.
Run unit tests before committing source changes.

groups.situation: The agent can run unit tests, then lint, and then commit the source changes.

rules.rule: Add a Markdown changelog when preparing every release.
Place every new Markdown document under `docs/`.
Keep all release metadata outside `docs/`.

groups.situation: A release is being prepared and its required new Markdown changelog is release metadata, so it must be both under and outside `docs/`.

rules.rule: Deploy every completed hotfix before handing the task back.
Deploy hotfixes only from tagged commits on `main`.
After hotfix CI passes on `main`, create the release tag before deployment.

groups.situation: The hotfix can be merged to `main`, pass CI, receive a release tag, and then be deployed before handoff.

rules.rule: Delete every merged task branch before the final handoff.
Delete a branch only after its tip has been tagged.
Never create tags for maintenance-only changes.

groups.situation: An untagged maintenance-only task branch has been merged and must be deleted before handoff, but deletion requires a tag that may not be created.

rules.rule: Commit every completed documentation fix before handing the task back.
Avoid documentation-only commits unless the task itself is documentation-only.
Keep documentation changes separate from source code unless both are required by the same task.

groups.situation: A documentation-only task can be committed by itself under the explicit exception and handed back.
